description: What the person changed since you last looked: replies (notes), new tasks, priority changes, unblocks. Call when you resume, between steps, and after blocking (with wait, to hold until the reply lands). Pass the cursor from the previous call (or from taskhold_begin / taskhold_block) as since. Your own changes are hidden unless include_agent is true. Returns one line per change, oldest first (time, who, task, what changed, task id), then the cursor for next time; with nothing new it says so and still gives a cursor. An unknown project returns no changes; an unknown task_id fails with "Task not found".

include_agent.description: Also include changes made by agents, yours included (default: the person's changes only)

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively (or a project id). An unknown name matches nothing.

since.description: Cursor from the previous call. Omit the first time (you get the latest 20).

task_id.description: Only changes to this task and its steps (e.g. the one you blocked)

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a change when there is none yet (0-50). Use after taskhold_block.

name: taskhold_updates
title: Get the person's updates
